issue_request: FHIR-35991 asked to make CodeSystem a MetadataResource, add the MetadataResource elements approvalDate, lastReviewDate, effectivePeriod, topic, author, editor, reviewer, endorser, and relatedArtifact, and deprecate the older CodeSystem metadata extensions replaced by those elements.
initial_application: Merge b6dd02933aa689169890719c75396529e3408925 / commit dcc502e4dc654e5ee1c7c86f011209f79936c98b first changed CodeSystem.baseDefinition from CanonicalResource to MetadataResource. Jira comments then clarified that this was incomplete; PR #2062, merged as c39cdc989629bdbde2038bfa2f21cda0bb2ce97e, added the explicit CodeSystem MetadataResource elements, metadata examples, search parameters, and deprecated the old core extension files that existed at the time.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini and current source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml uses the MetadataResource template/baseDefinition and contains the requested elements. The old core extension definition files are absent from current core source; remaining definitions are in the FHIR Extension Pack. Later extension-pack Jira decisions FHIR-43630/FHIR-43631 and FHIR-52827 specifically govern the codesystem-keyWord/valueSet-keyWord extension status after migration, including un-deprecating these extensions for pre-R5 use while pointing users to the R5 topic elements.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current core build source already reflects the issue request, and any future extension-definition adjustments belong in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than this core checkout.
